text: REJECT: the behaviour looks preserved, but `AnswersOnlyConstants` now only dispatches, and the bulk of the complexity moved into `BlockAnswersOnlyConstants`. By my count, the expression branch accounts for about 12 of the original 40, and the payload and return de-nesting saves only about 6, so the block method is still around 22, above the threshold of 15. I estimated this by hand and didn't run the analyzer or a build.
